source: Banker projections (Ray, email received 2026-08-07): 'Enterprise Value Inputs to Exit Window Simulation'. Quarterly TTM figures; EV = TTM EBITDA x EBITDA multiple.
basis: TTM (trailing-twelve-month) revenue and EBITDA — an EBITDA-multiple lens. The report-v6 cohort instead prices RATE SCENARIOS as revenue multiples on the $105M basis; the two tracks answer different questions (what the banker projects vs what rate paths do to pricing) and are shown side by side, never blended.

email_reference.note: ttm_ebitda is authoritative (the printed margin % is rounded to 1dp); default margins are derived as ebitda/revenue so default EVs reproduce the email to <$0.01M.
